title: Universality of the Basilica
summary: We establish universality of the fat Basilica Julia set $J(z^2-\frac34)$ in conformal dynamics in the following sense: $J(z^2-\frac34)$ is quasiconformally equivalent to the fat Basilica Julia set of any polynomial as well as to the limit set of any geometrically finite closed surface Bers boundary group. We thus obtain the first example of a connected rational Julia set, not homeomorphic to the circle or the sphere, that is quasiconformally equivalent to a Kleinian limit set.
